changes_this_cycle: Added software/validate_mundarica_artifact_registry.py as a deterministic, standard-library registry gate.

The validator checks registry identity, permanent source/volume consistency, unique artifact IDs, allowed roles, rights/access/verification metadata, repository-path safety and existence, optional SHA-256 integrity, and provenance source descriptions.

Encoded safety failures for scan authority on non-scan artifacts, authoritative scans without scan authority, working/raw OCR artifacts marked verified_against_scan, and verified-transcription role without verified_against_scan status.
Added tests that mutate the current registry to prove source/volume mismatch, false verification, false scan authority, and missing repository artifacts are rejected.
The validator emits a non-failing warning when open access coexists with unassessed/restricted-style rights metadata, preserving the rule that access never establishes reuse permission.
Wired registry validation and its dedicated tests into the MLHKP Streamlit Smoke Test before the existing artifact-contract, completeness, and UI gates.

streamlit_sync.detail: No Mundarica manifest, page count, transcription status, structured content, verification metric, story/term, or completeness value changed this cycle. Streamlit therefore remains synchronized with the existing manifest; its CI gate now rejects unsafe artifact-registry changes before public state can be accepted.

tests.state_at_record_time: triggered by validator/CI changes; final GitHub conclusion pending verification

next_best_action: After CI confirms the new registry gate, expose registry-validation health and registered-artifact/scan-presence counts as read-only Streamlit Mundarica audit metrics sourced from machine-readable data, without changing any verification state.
